title: Higher-Dimensional Symbolic Dynamics: A Textile Framework For 3-graphs
summary: Textile systems are best known to model two-dimensional shifts of finite type. In this article, we associate a discrete algebra with a textile system and provide a groupoid model for it. When the textile system is left-resolving, this algebra coincides with the Kumjian--Pask algebra of the associated $2$-graph.
